title: hordeum brevisubulatum
intro: Hordeum brevisubulatum, commonly known as the Tibetan barley, is a type of barley plant native to the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau. The plant has been used in traditional Tibetan medicine for centuries, offering various health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immune-modulating properties. Its therapeutic actions include relieving digestive issues, reducing blood sugar levels, and exhibiting anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents of Hordeum brevisubulatum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
